name: alluvium
description: Auto-archive Claude Code sessions to your Obsidian vault as a Karpathy-style LLM wiki.
author: Eric
_comment: Hooks invoke the alluvium binary which must be on PATH. See docs/HOOKS.md for the contract each hook upholds.

hooks.description: Resolve config, write per-session metadata, decide self-filter.
Snapshot transcript before compaction so original detail is not lost.
Spawn detached archive worker; hook returns within 100ms.
